decision_conditions: The works hereby permitted shall begin before the expiration of three years from the date of this consent.Reason: This is required by Section 18 of the Planning (Listed Building and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 (as amended).

Before the start of works, notification of the date and time of a site meeting between the Local Planning Authority and the persons responsible for undertaking the works shall be made in writing to the Local Planning Authority, to ensure thatthe conditions attached to the Listed Building Consent are understood and can be complied with in full. The minutes of the meeting shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. REASON: To ensure that special regard is paid to protecting the special architectural and historic interest and integrity of the building under Section 16 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 and National Planning Policy Framework, December 2025, Paragraphs 207 to 221; The London Plan 2021 Policy HC1; and RBK Core Strategy policy DM12.

Before the start of works details of the person who will supervise the hereby approved works of alteration or demolition shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The required detail shall include details of the person's qualifications, relevant experience and their supervisory role. The person shall be an appropriately qualified professional specialising in conservation work. Any proposed changes to the agreed supervision arrangements shall be subject to the prior written agreement of the Local Planning Authority.REASON: To ensure that special regard is paid to protecting the special architectural and historic interest and integrity of the building under Section 16 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 and National Planning Policy Framework, December 2025, Paragraphs 207 to 221; The London Plan 2021 Policy HC1; and RBK Core Strategy policy DM12.

During the works, if hidden historic features are revealed they shall be retained in-situ. Works shall be halted in the relevant area of the building and the Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately. Failure to do so may result in unauthorised works being carried out and an offence being committed.REASON: To ensure that special regard is paid to protecting the special architectural and historic interest and integrity of the building under Section 16 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 and National Planning Policy Framework, December 2025, Paragraphs 207 to 221; The London Plan 2021 Policy HC1; and RBK Core Strategy policy DM12.

The modern infill element between the Former Booking Hall and south stair, and the modern partition adjacent to the Former Ticket Office which are to be demolished shall be carefully dismantled by hand (not using power tools) taking care not to damage the adjacent historic features.REASON: To ensure that special regard is paid to protecting the special architectural and historic interest and integrity of the building under Section 16 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 and National Planning Policy Framework, December 2025, Paragraphs 207 to 221; The London Plan 2021 Policy HC1; and RBK Core Strategy policy DM12.

The position, type and method of installation of all new and relocated services and related fixtures (for the avoidance of doubt this includes communications and information technology servicing) including details of all electrical, drainage and plumbing and heating services for each floor plan and an appraisal how the proposal will impact on any historic fabric (including detail of any perforations to walls, floors and ceilings), shall be specified and agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority wherever these installations are to be visible, or where ducts or other methods of concealment are proposed. The works associated with the servicing shall be implemented only in accordance with such approval.REASON: To ensure that special regard is paid to protecting the special architectural and historic interest and integrity of the building under Section 16 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 and National Planning Policy Framework, December 2025, Paragraphs 207 to 221; The London Plan 2021 Policy HC1; and RBK Core Strategy policy DM12.

Before the start of works a Historic Features Protection Method Statement shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. This shall include drawings or specifications showing the method by which the existing marble wall panels, terrazzo flooring and original joinery, windows and doors are to be protected during building works so as to ensure their retention. The development and works relating to these historic features shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.REASON: To ensure that special regard is paid to protecting the special architectural and historic interest and integrity of the building under Section 16 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 and National Planning Policy Framework, December 2023, Paragraphs 195 to 214; The London Plan 2021 Policy HC1 Heritage conservation and growth; and Local plan policy DM12.

Detailed method statements with full particulars of the method for the repair andreinstatement of the following elements shall be submitted to and approved in writing by theLocal Planning Authority prior to the commencement of the relevant works. The works shallnot be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.1. The removal and relocation of the shelving from the Former Ticket Office to the Former Newspaper kiosk/Bookstall2. The cleaning and restoration of the timber telephone booths, newspaper kiosk/bookstall and tobacconist joinery3. The uncovering, cleaning and restoration of the 'glass-crete' rooflights to the Former Ticket Office windows4. The uncovering, cleaning and restoration of the timber frames and glass panes to the Former Ticket Office windowsREASON: To ensure that special regard is paid to protecting the special architectural and historic interest and integrity of the building under Section 16 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 and National Planning Policy Framework, December 2025, Paragraphs 207 to 221; The London Plan 2021 Policy HC1; and RBK Core Strategy policy DM12.

Detailed drawings and full particulars of the following elements - in the form of suitably scaled and annotated drawings, and manufacturer's specifications and images - shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of the relevant works. The works shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.1. All lighting, security cameras and other service or plant apparatus on the Front Elevation2. The two 'Double Royal' bronze poster panels on the Front Elevation3. The internal frieze lighting on the internal elevations of the the Former Booking Hall4. The new 'Crittall' doors between the Former Booking Hall and south stair5. The new terrazzo access panel in the Former Booking Hall6. The new folding hardwood doors and signage to the Former telephone booths7. The new shutter and signage to the Former newspaper kiosk/Bookstall8. The new half-glazed, timber panelled door and signage to the Former Tobacconist9. The new timber double doors between the Booking Hall and Back of House areas10. The new 'speak here' roundels in the Ticket Office windows11. Any required replacements to the 'glass-crete' rooflights in the Former Ticket Office12. The new textured glass panes to the Ticket Office windows13. The replacement door between the Former Ticket Office and Former Parcels Office14. The new fire-rated timber door between the Former Parcels Office and Lift Lobby15. The new plastered wall with clerestory windows between the Former Parcels Office and Lift LobbyREASON: To ensure that special regard is paid to protecting the special architectural and historic interest and integrity of the building under Section 16 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 and National Planning Policy Framework, December 2025, Paragraphs 207 to 221; The London Plan 2021 Policy HC1; and RBK Core Strategy policy DM12.

All new internal and external finishes relating to the development and the works hereby approved (and any other incidental works carried out in connection with the approved works) shall match the existing adjacent work in respect of the materials used, detailed execution and finished appearance including the methods used, material, dimensions, composition, form, colour, finish and profile, unless shown otherwise on the drawings or other documentation hereby approved or required by any condition(s) attached to this consent. The works shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved details.REASON: To ensure that special regard is paid to protecting the special architectural and historic interest and integrity of the building under Section 16 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 and National Planning Policy Framework, December 2025, Paragraphs 207 to 221; The London Plan 2021 Policy HC1; and RBK Core Strategy policy DM12.
